anchor.statement: Lemma B.4. After the parameters of the outer and axis profiles are fixed, one can take Λ , then C, sufficiently large, and then t 1 sufficiently small, so that on [X 0 , X i ] × [−1, 1] S q,r ≥ .94L Λ χ + 2.4, l r ≤ 1, v r := p 1,r + p 2 2,r p 1,r > 2 + c. (B.23) Here p 1,r > 0, and p 1,r > 3 for X b ≤ X ≤ X i . For each fixed k, the parameter norms of CE r , its reciprocal, p 1,r , and n s,r on [X 0 , X i ] have bounds independent of sufficiently large C and of 0 < t 1 ≤ ¯ t.

correspondence.note: Split into the bounds of (B.23) on [0, 110] × [−1, 1] (Sq,r > .94 LΛχ + 2.4, l_r ≤ 1, p1,r > 0, vr > 9/4 for X ≥ 4/Λ, p1,r > 3 at X = 100), p1,r > 3 on all of [100, 110], and the parameter-norm bounds for CEr, its reciprocal, p1,r and ns,r uniform in C ≥ 1 and the cutoff width. The constant c is 1/4.
